methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Melee uses stab (lowest stab defence). Dharok's-at-1HP is the standard affordable fast-kill; Twisted bow the high-end alt. Poison does not trigger her burrow.
recommendedFor: Players selecting this boss from the Boss meta-task
steps: Melee uses stab (lowest stab defence). Dharok's-at-1HP is the standard affordable fast-kill; Twisted bow the high-end alt. Poison does not trigger her burrow.

methods.label: Locator and burrow management
methods.summary: Use Falador shield locator support and high mobility to chase the Giant Mole after burrows.
steps: Enter the Falador Mole Lair with a light source and spade access.
Use Falador shield locator functionality where unlocked to find the Mole quickly after it burrows.
Keep run energy high so burrows do not waste most of the trip time.
Resume attacking immediately after reaching the new location.
risks: Without locator support, burrows make kills much slower.
Low run energy wastes time between hits.

methods.label: Melee, Dharok, or ranged alternative
methods.summary: Use stab melee, Dharok low-hitpoint damage, or high-end ranged depending account gear and risk preference.
prayers: Piety or ranged prayers depending setup
steps: Use stab melee because the Mole has lower stab defence than other melee defences.
Use Dharok's at low hitpoints only when comfortable with the risk-management setup.
Use Twisted bow or other ranged alternatives when they outperform available melee gear.
Do not rely on poison to stop burrowing.
notes: Poison does not prevent the Mole from burrowing.
